summary: Verified Rapido-style low fare pricing on backend fare API, rental package pricing on Rentals page, delivery fare formula, and critical price-sync between top vehicle cards, blue Total (Cash) box, and Book button. All 16 backend tests pass (13 workflow + 3 new fare tests). Frontend price-sync verified for Bike/Auto/Car — card₹ === Total(Cash)₹ === Book button ₹ for each vehicle selection. Rentals page shows new lower prices (Bike 99/189/349, Auto 149/289/549, Car 249/479/899). Cancellation modal + user->driver workflow + 3 quick-login buttons continue to work (regression clean).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 2056 lines — should be modularized (RiderView, DriverView, AdminView, RentalsView, DeliveryView, modals/) for maintainability.

Delivery fare is computed client-side only (App.js:428) with hardcoded base/perKm. Consider a backend /api/delivery/estimate endpoint so the client and server fare logic stay in sync and can be A/B priced centrally.

Fare pricing table (bases/per_km/per_min) is duplicated in server.py (calculate_fare_options) and App.js (ridePresets). If one is updated and the other missed, the top-card fallback drifts from the API. Consider exposing a /api/config/pricing endpoint or removing the client-side fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fare API verified: 15.5km/28min => {Bike:90, Auto:133, Car:201}; 5km/15min => {Bike:40, Auto:61, Car:97}. Frontend selectedVehicle triggers fareOptions[vehicleType] which is populated by /api/fares/estimate; the top card also renders fareOptions[v.type] so card, Total(Cash), and Book button all read from the same source of truth. Rental testids follow pattern book-rental-{type}-{price} with prices Bike:99/189/349 Auto:149/289/549 Car:249/479/899.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Previous fare-mismatch RCA (top-card computed via local formula while Total used API result) was resolved by main agent by making both read fareOptions[v.type] (App.js:995 and :1024,1036).
